title: The Tool in Three Dimensions: Forward Kinematics of a Six and a Seven Joint Arm, the Tool Offset, and Roll Pitch Yaw With Its Hole at Ninety Degrees

artifact.note: forward kinematics of an arm from its table: each joint's row read in the table's convention with the joint angle and its offset, the frames of all the links, the tool as the base times the rows times a tool offset, a check against the joint limits, and the orientation as roll pitch yaw (the order z, y, x) with the convention that fixes the yaw at zero where the pitch is a quarter turn
